{{Quote|Is that Chrimar Noven? That's a free nobleman of Alderaan!|Lord Jorad Thul|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Chrimar Noven''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He pretended to ally with [[House of Thul|House Thul]] but in truth he supported the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was exposed by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] and brought to [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Jorad Sindarus Thul|Jorad Thul]] for trial and verdict.
